from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanySalesExpense(BaseModel):
    """A single company's selling expense from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The company's security/trading code, if available")
    selling_expense: float | None = Field(description="The selling expense amount for the period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. 'CNY' or '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_sales_expenses: list[CompanySalesExpense]
